content.short: XSTAR is a Web3 social protocol on Mantle enabling content creators to build tokenized communities and monetize their audiences on-chain.
content.description: XSTAR is a decentralized social protocol that empowers content creators to build tokenized fan communities and monetize their relationships with audiences directly on-chain. Creators can launch social tokens, NFT memberships, and gated content experiences that give fans verifiable ownership stakes in their favorite creators' ecosystems. XSTAR is deployed on Mantle, leveraging the network's low fees to make social token interactions economically viable for creators and fans at all levels.
